svg.aria-label: PWRSWriteColorEX is PSWriteColorEX written in Rust with PWRS (PoWerRuSt). It has the same commands, parameters, aliases and PSColorStyle class, and writes the same output, so a script written for PSWriteColorEX runs with it unchanged, in a fraction of the time. Its major and minor version are PSWriteColorEX's, and its patch number may differ.
